description: Show what this mail server has done: every tool call with time, account, identifying details (ids, recipients, subject, query; never email bodies) and success/failure. Use it to answer "what did you change / send / draft?". Newest first.

account.description: Only calls that targeted this account alias/email.

onlyChanges.description: Hide read-only calls such as searches (default false).

since.description: Only entries at/after this ISO time, e.g. 2026-10-26T00:00:00Z.

name: view_audit_log
title: View the audit log
